disclaimer: Parkin tariffs and Nol fares change. Verify with parkin.ae and rta.ae before quoting figures. CRITICAL: 'Mawaqif' is Abu Dhabi, not Dubai. Dubai paid parking is operated by Parkin Company PJSC.

naming_correction.explanation: Mawaqif is the Abu Dhabi parking system. Dubai paid parking is run by Parkin Company PJSC. Use 'Parkin' or 'Dubai parking' in tools, never 'Mawaqif'.

tariffs.vat_note: From 2026-06-01 a 5% VAT applies on top of these base tariffs, so displayed prices are VAT-inclusive (e.g. the AED 6 premium peak hour displays as AED 6.30, the AED 4 standard hour as AED 4.20).

vat.summary: 5% VAT applies to all Parkin public parking tariffs and services from 1 June 2026, remitted to the Federal Tax Authority. Base tariffs are unchanged; VAT is added on top, so displayed prices are now VAT-inclusive.

payments.note: Cash and coin payments at parking meters are phased out from 1 June 2026 under Dubai's Cashless Strategy. Nol cards are still accepted at meters; otherwise pay via the Parkin app, mParking SMS (with SMS surcharge), or card and other digital channels.

zones.unverified_note: The official subscription page confirms Dubai Hills 631G and Dubai Silicon Oasis H. Other retained letters still need current first-party confirmation.

new_paid_areas_2026.note: Regulated paid parking operated by Parkonic. Typical new-community pattern: AED 2 per 30 min/hour up to AED 36 per 24h in premium zones, enforced 08:00-22:00 Monday-Saturday, free Sundays and public holidays, subscriptions from about AED 300/month.

mall_parking.summary: Parkin expanded into mall parking in 2026 with barrierless (ANPR) operations and AI-driven enforcement deals.
mall_parking.majid_al_futtaim: Barrierless parking live at Mall of the Emirates since 2026-02-03 under a 5-year Majid Al Futtaim deal that also covers City Centre Deira and City Centre Mirdif (~21,000 spaces; mall tariffs unchanged).
mall_parking.emaar: AI-driven enforcement agreement (May 2026) covering Dubai Mall, Dubai Hills Mall, and Marina Mall using licence-plate recognition.
mall_parking.al_futtaim: 5-year enforcement deal (May 2026) with Al Futtaim Group covering Dubai Festival City Mall, Festival Plaza, and Arabian Centre.
mall_parking.secure_parking_jv: Partnership with Secure Parking announced 2026-04-15 to roll out 60,000 barrier-free smart parking spaces across the UAE.

mparking.example: Send 'A12345 A1 2' to 7275 for 2 hours in zone A1 with plate A12345.
mparking.note: The 'P2335' code that appears in older guides is NOT a system-wide code.

datasets_status.rta_parking_rates_open: OBSOLETE per the publisher. Predates the April 2025 variable tariff and cannot be trusted as a current rate source.
datasets_status.real_time_availability: No public real-time availability API. Parkin holds it internally.

rta_fares.transfer_note: 30-minute multi-modal transfer rule applies (metro to bus, bus to tram, etc.).
rta_fares.gtfs_fares_status: rta_gtfs-open feed may include fare_attributes.txt and fare_rules.txt. UNVERIFIED. Download the 7z to confirm.
rta_fares.pass_scope: All-zone regular-class passes. Registered cards are required for 30-, 90-, and 365-day passes; anonymous silver/gold cards support 7-day passes only.
rta_fares.daily_cap_note: The current RTA fare table does not establish an automatic daily cap. Do not confuse e-purse fares with separately purchased travel-pass products.
rta_fares.gold_class_note: Gold surcharge applies on metro and tram; there is no separate Gold bus seating product.

nol_cards.best_for: Gold Class metro and tram travel
Registered, replaceable if lost, supports concessionary fares
